create_LinearizedConvolution: create a LinearizedConvolution module with specified in_channels, out_channels, and kernel_size for optimized 1D convolution
run_forward_training: run the forward pass in training mode with Time x Batch x Channel input using ConvTBC
run_forward_inference: run the forward pass in inference mode with incremental_state for one time step at a time generation
reorder_incremental_state: reorder the incremental state input buffer according to a new batch ordering tensor
upgrade_state_dict: upgrade an existing state dict by removing the redundant _linearized_weight key
